decision.rationale: V3 did not improve complete evidence, regressed atomic recall and region nDCG, and kept a vision tower resident online. Apply the stop rule and do not tune this configuration on the same development cases.
limitations: The run covered only three failed visual cases and six fixed controls.
No held-out case was loaded or scored.
Workstation latency is not concurrent two-vCPU server capacity evidence.
A separately exported text-only CLIP tower was not tested because it would not repair the observed quality regression.
